title: A market finds its price

bodies.name: Chart board
bodies.label: Demand and supply curves
bodies.describe: Blue: how many would buy at each price. Red: how many would sell. The gold line is the current price.

bodies.name: Stall
bodies.label: The stall · where trades happen
bodies.describe: Every buyer and seller who steps up here trades; the quantity traded is the smaller group.

bodies.name: Price
bodies.label: Price
bodies.describe: Rises while more want to buy than sell, falls while more want to sell than buy.

bodies.name: Buyer 1
bodies.label: Buyers
bodies.describe: Each buyer has a different willingness to pay; they step up to the stall when the price is below it.

bodies.name: Seller 1
bodies.label: Sellers
bodies.describe: Each seller has a different cost; they step up to sell when the price is above it.

lessons.title: From a low price to the clearing price
lessons.text: The price starts low: many buyers step up, few sellers. Watch the price climb until the two groups at the stall match.
lessons.explain: At the clearing price quantity demanded equals quantity supplied; any other price leaves a shortage or a surplus that pushes it back.

lessons.title: Buyers get richer
lessons.text: Raise income. Every buyer will now pay more: the blue curve shifts right, and the price climbs to a new, higher clearing point.
lessons.explain: A rise in demand raises both the equilibrium price and the quantity traded.

lessons.title: Costs rise
lessons.text: Raise the sellers' cost. The red curve shifts left: the price rises further but fewer units change hands.
lessons.explain: A fall in supply raises the price and lowers the quantity.

lessons.title: A nervous market
lessons.text: Make the price adjust quickly and watch it overshoot and settle.
lessons.explain: The equilibrium is the same; only the path to it changes.

sources.title: An Experimental Study of Competitive Market Behavior
